after-grim-tales.player: How is the collection going now?

after-grim-tales.npc: Thanks to you finding the golden goblin for me, I am the envy of the collector's group. I can't thank you enough.

steps.player: I think I've lost Rupert's helmet.

No, no. Thanks for everything you've done!

after-grim-tales.player: I'm just happy that I could help. Goodbye!
